title: The stage backfill sizes batches from its update alone and counts remaining rows cheaply
description: On a running test install, the stage backfill sizes each batch from the update time alone and computes remaining rows at most once a minute so remaining rows fall by at least 1,000 within ten loop cycles and reach zero.

steps.name: the backfill's remaining rows fall by at least 1,000 within ten loop cycles and reach zero
